title: Preview Folder Sizes Safely with Python 🐍
narration: Want to see which folders use the most space without changing a single file? Python can help. Start with pathlib and choose a folder you own. Walk through each file, check its size, and add the values for every top-level folder. Sort the results from largest to smallest, then print only the first five. Wrap file access in a try block so locked files do not stop the scan. This script only reads file information and prints a report. Review the results yourself before taking any action. Subscribe to Amala for practical Python tips.
description: Learn a safe, read-only Python pattern for previewing folder sizes before making decisions.
